_comment: Contract for bridge actions. `client` is the CLI subcommand when it differs from the action name. `required`/`optional` are the client argparse positional/flag args. Checked against HANDLERS (control.lua) and factorio_ai.py by contract_check.py.

brief.note: one reply: owned counts, issues, enemies, ore_total/ore_patches, nearest_water, treasury

blueprint_export.note: read built area into Factorio blueprint string; client writes a new file

blueprint_import.note: default direct construction debits real treasury items; --ghosts defers construction to robots; --direction rotates 0/4/8/12

blueprint_run.note: generic executor: agent contract (site/resources/primer/feeds/verify) -> site search, real-item gather, build, prime, holdout audit

blueprint_job.note: executor job state + every holdout window

index.note: whole-map ore/enemy/water index, cached in mod storage

ore_marks.note: persistent ore sectors found by index, paged and filtered by resource

smelt_plan.note: size/site/preflight a reusable iron-smelting row in one call; no construction

smelt_build.note: revalidate, build with real items, export blueprint and start in-game audit

smelt_status.note: compact result for the exact row, including a 60-game-second production audit

starter_smelt.note: one-call real-coal bootstrap, direct burner drill to furnace and in-game audit

starter_status.note: compact starter job progress and measured plate output

coal_stockpile.note: one burner drill drops real coal into adjacent chest and audits output

repair_demo_economy.note: one-time exact Sandbox ingredient debit for cheat-mode crafting demo

autofuel.note: client arg state on|off maps to action field enabled(bool)

audit.note: expected_per_second is client-only, not sent to Lua

insert.note: input for lab/assembler/ammo-turret, chest storage, furnace source when requested, else fuel

place.note: dry_run reports blockers; type input/output applies only to underground-belt

water_sites.note: offshore-pump spots nearest x,y + blocked spots with obstacles

recall.note: mine own-force entities + contents into player bag; MCP also takes an entity list
